The '''Orinian Empire''' is a regional power in [[Khalari]]. The extracted source says it was established in 1680 by Adam Bako and built its status through leadership, legacy, and regional influence.

== Regional Position ==

Orinia is shown on the 2003 and 2022 reference maps as a large Khalari state near the [[Svetkhanul Republic]], [[Arabogradsk-Hamed Caliphate]], and Volgastani sphere. The source says Orinia maintained ties with the [[Union of Zhensanov]] and some neighboring states.

== Volgastan And AGGPI ==

The source states that Orinia is wary of the [[Volgastan Baathist Republic]] because both states compete for regional-power status in Khalari. It also mentions distrust of [[AGGPI]] due to later actions, but this draft treats that as a post-1994 or undated source note unless a pre-1995 incident is confirmed.

== War Reference ==

The source list of wars names the [[Svet-Orinan War]] of 1973-1975. This draft preserves the war as a pre-1994 Orinian conflict but does not create an outcome or territorial claim beyond the listed dates.
